description: Current local time, UTC offset, DST status and the next clock change for a place or time zone. Uses the latest IANA tz data (more current than most runtimes). Accepts city names in German or English, time zone names ("Central Time", "MEZ") or IANA IDs.

at.description: Optional ISO 8601 instant with offset, e.g. "2026-12-01T12:00:00Z". Default: now.

zone.description: Place, time zone name or IANA ID, e.g. "San Diego", "Central Time", "Europe/Berlin".

name: get_time
title: Uhrzeit eines Ortes
